explanation: A title that shows respect and reverence for God, acknowledging his authority and power.
One who saves or delivers from danger or destruction. In Psalm 144 it refers to God as the protector and deliverer of his people.
An armed conflict between two or more groups. In this context it refers to the battles the people of Israel had to fight against their enemies.
Persons or groups who are opposed to or wish harm upon another person or group. In Psalm 144 it refers to the nations that threatened Israel.
Power, energy, or ability to carry out actions. In this context it refers to God's strength that helps people in their struggles.
A part of the human body used to grasp and manipulate objects. In this context it represents God's protective and helping hand.
A weapon with a long blade used for cutting and thrusting. In this context it symbolizes war and battle, and God's protection against enemies.
A song or poem that expresses gratitude, honor, and glory to God for his goodness and grace.
A state of material wealth and well-being. In Psalm 144 David asks that God would bless his people with prosperity and security.
